question: Can the complete native Ash VenomStrike/poison/Catalyst package be identified with an applicable closed/admitted package or an allowed composition, without substituting a different registered producer, hiding observable state, or using an unrelated background-preview difference as novelty?

candidate.background: Exact unmodified current source, including Ashen Core, public queries, all acquisition paths, costs, target/instance identity, death, transfer, expiry, replay and save contracts.

comparison_rules: Distinguish a registered package closure from a failed whole-content candidate, a fixed controller-family failure, and ordinary inherited background. Do not extend a negative beyond its actual claim.
Erase labels and implementation carriers, not producer/mediator/consumer roles, public observations, target multiplicity, costs or lifecycle.

A proposed composition must state its primitive components and every wiring, sequencing, sharing, projection or deletion operator. Do not silently restrict it to complete packages if the applicable closure also permits component decompositions.

Prove an equivalence/decomposition by a complete source-bound relation and permitted operations. Prove non-equivalence to a composition class by a sound invariant covering the entire class, not by checking a few chosen compositions.
A difference in unrelated public preview is a failed background bridge, not a new package law. Existing source/frame results are inputs and are not rerun.
No implicit promotion from a scoped named-family comparison to the complete applicable closed-family quotient. An unknown applicable component or permitted operator prevents formal admission.
outputs: Machine-readable source and closure applicability bindings
Checkable complete-scope proof or an exact unresolved obligation with a countermodel to an invalid shortcut
Focused falsification tests and remote byte-readback

decision.eligible: Only a full-scope source-bound comparison covering all applicable registered laws and permitted compositions opens the unified mixed-background causal/null/subset/descriptor/policy/peer/economy contract.
decision.equivalent_or_decomposable: Close precisely the current distinctness claim, preserve historical scopes, and continue only with an already authorised non-equivalent alternative.
decision.inconclusive: Do not open population confirmation or manufacture a complete quotient by omitting operators, background, acquisition or observables. Preserve the exact missing obligation and completed proof.
